thread:
elaine: Heads-up — bringing a small pile of handhelds to the mezzanine swap tonight. AGS-101 GBA, a beat-up PSP (battery pops out), and a boxed Game Boy Micro. Anyone need a charger or want to trade? :eyes:
mike: I can bring my EverDrive and a USB-to-AAA adapter. Bringing a tiny soldering kit too in case anyone wants a quick backlight install. :wrench:
priya: I have a PSP Go + proprietary cable. Can bring but no charger atm. Also happy to borrow that EverDrive for a quick demo if ok. :raised_hand:
jay: FYI the mezz outlet by the couch is weird — last time it tripped with two chargers. Might be worth bringing a power strip with surge. :zap:
sam: I vote projector + couch for tonight. If someone can lug it, I’ll bring snacks. :popcorn: @mike can you swing the EverDrive demo table?
mike: Yep I’ll bring projector HDMI adapter too. Quick note — EverDrive has region-free saves but, if you’re into repro carts, please label them. We had a mixup last time. :memo:
elaine: Good call on labeling. Also does anyone have a flashcart for PSP or a memory stick adapter? I’d hate to wipe anything.
priya: I have a tiny memory stick micro adapter, can bring it.
eventbot: Reminder: Retro Swap tonight 7:00 PM — Mezzanine. React :thumbsup: if you’re coming.
jay: :thumbsup: count me in
mike: :thumbsup:
elaine: :thumbsup: probably bringing one guest
sam: Quick poll — who wants a mini tournament? Smash handheld bracket? React :game_die: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for nah.
priya: :game_die:
mike: :game_die:
jay: :no_entry_sign: - I’m there for the snacks and chaos
elaine: If anyone needs to borrow a small multi-USB charger DM me. Also please label batteries. I still have PTSD from the AA swap incident. :sweat_smile:
